The '''Rynmar Trail''' was a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] in the [[Hapan Rim Worlds]],<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Gateworlds]],<ref name="TEA" /> and the [[Rifle Worlds]]<ref name="TEA" /> of the [[Hapes Cluster/Legends|Hapes Cluster]]. It started at the [[Rynmar system/Legends|Rynmar system]] then traveled to the [[Febrini system/Legends|Febrini system]],<ref name="TEA" /> from which it connected to the [[Sargon system/Legends|Sargon system]],<ref name="TEA" /> then the [[Modus system/Legends|Modus system]],<ref name="TEA" /> and finally ended at the [[Vergill system/Legends|Vergill system]].
